assumptions.statement: All spatial layers are generated on the organization-provided provisional boundary (PROV-SITE-001, PROV-KEY-001/002/003) because the official announcement does not publish exact polygons as of 2026-08-10.
assumptions.impact: Site boundary, key areas, land use, buildings, roads, green space, public space, phasing, and all area metrics must be recalculated after official polygons are released.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls (FAR, height, density, green ratio, setbacks, road redlines), ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission for provided provisional boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The 24 building footprints are conceptual illustrations for design discussion, not statutory floor area, building scale, or demolition/renovation conclusions.
assumptions.impact: No building-scale or parcel-level conclusion should be drawn from buildings.geojson before existing-condition and ownership data are available.

assumptions.statement: AI scenarios, events, investment, funding, and policy arrangements are conceptual suggestions and deepening directions for professional teams; they are not confirmed government decisions or implementation commitments.
assumptions.impact: None of these claims may be presented as approved arrangements; each requires separate authorization and compliance review before any pilot.

assumptions.statement: proposal.md (zh) and proposal.en.md (en) are equivalent translations with aligned chapters, claims, metrics, evidence references, and figure positions.
assumptions.impact: Any later edit to one language must be mirrored in the other before rerunning render/finalize/self-check.
